_comment: Asian board for the 2026-09-16 slate (Taipei 09-17). Sixteenth slate of the prospective test. Twelve of the fifteen games on the US card; White Sox at Guardians, Giants at Cardinals and Braves at Cubs are on the card but not this board. No reading conflict: all twelve favourites agree with the US moneyline, and the board's own moneyline column, shown in ten of the twelve, agrees as well. Of the two without it, Tigers at Blue Jays matches cleanly at 0.5530 with all fifteen books above even, and Red Sox at Rangers is the thinnest call on the board -- the median is exactly 0.5000 with seven of eleven books a shade toward Boston and four toward Texas, which agrees with the row I read but by very little. Red Sox at Rangers also shows the row mismatch withdrawn as a tell on 09-11: the full-game handicap sits on Boston's row and the first-half handicap on Texas's. It is recorded, not used. Handicaps flat at 0.950, totals flat at 0.940, no split prices.
